Ffmpeg._comment: Leave both blank to just call 'ffmpeg'/'ffprobe' from PATH. Point these at a specific binary (e.g. tools/ffmpeg/bin/ffmpeg from `make ffmpeg-custom`, or a faster third-party build) to override. Can also be set via FFMPEG__FFMPEGPATH / FFMPEG__FFPROBEPATH env vars.

Conversion._comment: How every upload is encoded (server admin only; uploaders can't change this). Preset: LowestSize (AV1+AAC) | Conservative (HEVC, NVENC/AMF if available else libx265, AAC) | WebOptimized (H.264+AAC). Container: Mp4 | Mkv. ForceCopyAudioIfSupported copies aac/mp3/opus audio instead of re-encoding (wma is always re-encoded). ResolutionTargets: 'original' or e.g. '480,720,1080,2160' (anything taller than the source is skipped). Env vars: CONVERSION__PRESET etc.

Database._comment: Provider is 'Sqlite' or 'MySql'. SqlitePath is only used for Sqlite (relative paths resolve against the app's content root, not the current working directory). MySqlServerVersion pins the version dotnet-ef assumes at design time so it doesn't need a live server just to add a migration - 'auto' restores live detection at runtime.
